I'll improve the solution by adding log-transformed distance features (log of haversine distance). Taxi fares typically have a base fare plus per-mile charges, creating a non-linear relationship between distance and fare amount. The log transformation helps capture this non-linearity better than raw distance alone, which should provide additional signal to the LightGBM model without significantly increasing training time.

import pandas as pd

# Feature engineering function
def add_features(df):
    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])

    # Extract temporal features
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Cyclical encoding for temporal features
    df["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["day_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)
    df["day_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)
    df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    df["quarter"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.quarter

    # Rush hour features
    df["is_morning_rush"] = ((df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] < 10)).astype(int)
    df["is_evening_rush"] = ((df["hour"] >= 17) & (df["hour"] < 20)).astype(int)
    df["is_rush_hour"] = df["is_morning_rush"] | df["is_evening_rush"]
    df["is_peak_time"] = (
        (df["hour"] >= 11) & (df["hour"] < 15)
        | (df["hour"] >= 17) & (df["hour"] < 21)
        | (df["is_weekend"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    # Haversine distance calculation
    def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        R = 3959  # Earth's radius in miles
        lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
        dlat = lat2 - lat1
        dlon = lon2 - lon1
        a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
        c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
        return R * c

    df["haversine_distance"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
    )

    # NEW: Log-transformed distance features for non-linear fare relationship
    df["log_haversine_distance"] = np.log1p(df["haversine_distance"])
    df["log_manhattan_distance"] = np.log1p(
        np.abs(df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"])
        + np.abs(df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"])
    )

    # Manhattan distance
    df["manhattan_distance"] = np.abs(
        df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]
    ) + np.abs(df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"])

    # Coordinate interaction features
    df["pickup_dropoff_lat_diff"] = df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]
    df["pickup_dropoff_lon_diff"] = df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"]
    df["pickup_dropoff_lat_product"] = df["pickup_latitude"] * df["dropoff_latitude"]
    df["pickup_dropoff_lon_product"] = df["pickup_longitude"] * df["dropoff_longitude"]

    # Center point features
    df["center_latitude"] = (df["pickup_latitude"] + df["dropoff_latitude"]) / 2
    df["center_longitude"] = (df["pickup_longitude"] + df["dropoff_longitude"]) / 2

    # Bearing/Direction features between pickup and dropoff
    def calculate_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
        dlon = lon2 - lon1
        y = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2)
        x = np.cos(lat1) * np.sin(lat2) - np.sin(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.cos(dlon)
        bearing = np.arctan2(y, x)
        bearing_deg = np.degrees(bearing)
        return (bearing_deg + 360) % 360  # Normalize to 0-360

    df["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
    )

    # Cyclical encoding for bearing (direction)
    df["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["bearing"] / 360)
    df["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["bearing"] / 360)

    # Cardinal direction bins (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
    df["cardinal_direction"] = (df["bearing"] // 45).astype(int) % 8

    # Distance to Manhattan center features
    MANHATTAN_CENTER_LAT = 40.7831
    MANHATTAN_CENTER_LON = -73.9712

    df["pickup_to_center_distance"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["pickup_latitude"].values, MANHATTAN_CENTER_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["pickup_longitude"].values, MANHATTAN_CENTER_LON),
    )

    df["dropoff_to_center_distance"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_latitude"].values, MANHATTAN_CENTER_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_longitude"].values, MANHATTAN_CENTER_LON),
    )

    # Trip direction and zone features
    df["pickup_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.72)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.82)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.02)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.92)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.72)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.82)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.02)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.92)
    ).astype(int)

    df["trip_direction"] = df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] - df["pickup_in_manhattan"]
    df["distance_to_center_diff"] = (
        df["pickup_to_center_distance"] - df["dropoff_to_center_distance"]
    )
    df["zone_combo"] = df["pickup_in_manhattan"] * 2 + df["dropoff_in_manhattan"]

    # Borough zone features
    df["pickup_in_brooklyn"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.57)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.73)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.05)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.83)
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_in_queens"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.54)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.80)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -73.96)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.70)
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_in_bronx"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.78)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.92)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -73.93)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.76)
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_in_staten"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.48)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.65)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.25)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -74.05)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_brooklyn"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.57)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.73)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.05)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.83)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_queens"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.54)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.80)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -73.96)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.70)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_bronx"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.78)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.92)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -73.93)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.76)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_staten"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.48)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.65)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.25)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -74.05)
    ).astype(int)

    # Borough crossing features
    df["crosses_borough_boundary"] = (
        (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] != df["dropoff_in_manhattan"])
        | (df["pickup_in_brooklyn"] != df["dropoff_in_brooklyn"])
        | (df["pickup_in_queens"] != df["dropoff_in_queens"])
        | (df["pickup_in_bronx"] != df["dropoff_in_bronx"])
        | (df["pickup_in_staten"] != df["dropoff_in_staten"])
    ).astype(int)

    # Borough combo features (pickup_borough * 5 + dropoff_borough)
    df["pickup_borough_id"] = (
        df["pickup_in_manhattan"] * 4
        + df["pickup_in_brooklyn"] * 3
        + df["pickup_in_queens"] * 2
        + df["pickup_in_bronx"] * 1
        + df["pickup_in_staten"] * 0
    )
    df["dropoff_borough_id"] = (
        df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] * 4
        + df["dropoff_in_brooklyn"] * 3
        + df["dropoff_in_queens"] * 2
        + df["dropoff_in_bronx"] * 1
        + df["dropoff_in_staten"] * 0
    )
    df["borough_combo"] = df["pickup_borough_id"] * 5 + df["dropoff_borough_id"]

    # Airport proximity features
    JFK_LAT, JFK_LON = 40.6413, -73.7781
    LGA_LAT, LGA_LON = 40.7769, -73.8740
    EWR_LAT, EWR_LON = 40.6895, -74.1745

    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["pickup_latitude"].values, JFK_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["pickup_longitude"].values, JFK_LON),
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["pickup_latitude"].values, LGA_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["pickup_longitude"].values, LGA_LON),
    )
    df["pickup_to_ewr"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["pickup_latitude"].values, EWR_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["pickup_longitude"].values, EWR_LON),
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_latitude"].values, JFK_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_longitude"].values, JFK_LON),
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_latitude"].values, LGA_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_longitude"].values, LGA_LON),
    )
    df["dropoff_to_ewr"] = haversine_distance(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_latitude"].values, EWR_LAT),
        np.full_like(df["dropoff_longitude"].values, EWR_LON),
    )

    df["pickup_near_jfk"] = (df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 3).astype(int)
    df["pickup_near_lga"] = (df["pickup_to_lga"] < 3).astype(int)
    df["pickup_near_ewr"] = (df["pickup_to_ewr"] < 3).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_near_jfk"] = (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 3).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_near_lga"] = (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 3).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_near_ewr"] = (df["dropoff_to_ewr"] < 3).astype(int)

    df["airport_trip"] = (
        df["pickup_near_jfk"]
        | df["pickup_near_lga"]
        | df["pickup_near_ewr"]
        | df["dropoff_near_jfk"]
        | df["dropoff_near_lga"]
        | df["dropoff_near_ewr"]
    ).astype(int)

    df["city_to_airport"] = (
        (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] == 1)
        & (df["dropoff_near_jfk"] | df["dropoff_near_lga"] | df["dropoff_near_ewr"])
    ).astype(int)
    df["airport_to_city"] = (
        (df["pickup_near_jfk"] | df["pickup_near_lga"] | df["pickup_near_ewr"])
        & (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)
    df["airport_to_airport"] = (
        (df["pickup_near_jfk"] | df["pickup_near_lga"] | df["pickup_near_ewr"])
        & (df["dropoff_near_jfk"] | df["dropoff_near_lga"] | df["dropoff_near_ewr"])
    ).astype(int)

    df["jfk_to_city"] = (df["pickup_near_jfk"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] == 1)
    df["lga_to_city"] = (df["pickup_near_lga"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] == 1)
    df["ewr_to_city"] = (df["pickup_near_ewr"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] == 1)
    df["city_to_jfk"] = (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_near_jfk"] == 1)
    df["city_to_lga"] = (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_near_lga"] == 1)
    df["city_to_ewr"] = (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_near_ewr"] == 1)

    df["airport_trip_type"] = (
        df["city_to_airport"] * 1
        + df["airport_to_city"] * 2
        + df["airport_to_airport"] * 3
    )

    # Interaction features with bearing/direction
    df["distance_bearing_sin"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["bearing_sin"]
    df["distance_bearing_cos"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["bearing_cos"]

    # Interaction features with cyclical temporal encoding
    df["distance_hour_sin"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["hour_sin"]
    df["distance_hour_cos"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["hour_cos"]
    df["distance_day_sin"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["day_sin"]
    df["distance_day_cos"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["day_cos"]
    df["distance_month_sin"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["month_sin"]
    df["distance_month_cos"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["month_cos"]

    # Passenger count interactions with distance
    df["distance_passenger"] = df["haversine_distance"] * df["passenger_count"]

    # Borough-specific distance interactions
    df["distance_manhattan_pickup"] = (
        df["haversine_distance"] * df["pickup_in_manhattan"]
    )
    df["distance_manhattan_dropoff"] = (
        df["haversine_distance"] * df["dropoff_in_manhattan"]
    )
    df["distance_cross_borough"] = (
        df["haversine_distance"] * df["crosses_borough_boundary"]
    )

    # NEW: Log distance interactions
    df["log_distance_hour_sin"] = df["log_haversine_distance"] * df["hour_sin"]
    df["log_distance_hour_cos"] = df["log_haversine_distance"] * df["hour_cos"]
    df["log_distance_day_sin"] = df["log_haversine_distance"] * df["day_sin"]
    df["log_distance_day_cos"] = df["log_haversine_distance"] * df["day_cos"]
    df["log_distance_passenger"] = df["log_haversine_distance"] * df["passenger_count"]

    # Congestion zone features - NYC has specific congestion pricing zones
    # Central Manhattan congestion zone (roughly south of 60th Street)
    df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.70)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.76)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.02)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.93)
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.70)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.76)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.02)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.93)
    ).astype(int)

    # Congestion zone trip types
    df["enters_congestion_zone"] = (
        (df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] == 0) & (df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)
    df["exits_congestion_zone"] = (
        (df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"] == 0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["within_congestion_zone"] = (
        (df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] == 1) & (df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    # Congestion zone distance (if trip involves congestion zone)
    df["congestion_zone_distance"] = df["haversine_distance"] * (
        df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] | df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"]
    ).astype(int)

    # Congestion zone time interactions (peak hours have higher congestion pricing)
    df["congestion_peak_pickup"] = (
        df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"]
        & (
            (df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] < 10)
            | (df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] < 19)
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["congestion_peak_dropoff"] = (
        df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"]
        & (
            (df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] < 10)
            | (df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] < 19)
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["congestion_peak_trip"] = (
        df["congestion_peak_pickup"] | df["congestion_peak_dropoff"]
    ).astype(int)

    # Congestion zone interaction with distance
    df["distance_congestion_pickup"] = (
        df["haversine_distance"] * df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"]
    )
    df["distance_congestion_dropoff"] = (
        df["haversine_distance"] * df["dropoff_in_congestion_zone"]
    )
    df["distance_congestion_cross"] = df["haversine_distance"] * (
        df["enters_congestion_zone"] | df["exits_congestion_zone"]
    ).astype(int)

    # Congestion zone interaction with time
    df["congestion_hour_sin"] = df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] * df["hour_sin"]
    df["congestion_hour_cos"] = df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] * df["hour_cos"]
    df["congestion_day_sin"] = df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] * df["day_sin"]
    df["congestion_day_cos"] = df["pickup_in_congestion_zone"] * df["day_cos"]

    # Drop the datetime column
    df.drop("pickup_datetime", axis=1, inplace=True)

    return df
